🚆 NEW: The Sky Station!
Explore a station above the clouds, and survive what's lurking underground... (The content added is not Chapter 2, but rather a new dream somewhere in Chapter 1.)
Think Sky Station is too easy? Unlock Nightmare Mode for a harder challenge!

⚠️ This is a short, unfinished early access demo. Chapters and features are still being built and may change.

A slow, dream-based narrative story game with quiet horror undertones, inspired by liminal spaces, dreamcore, and weirdcore!

Everything is easier to deal with tomorrow, right? You fall asleep, avoid your problems, and fall asleep again. In your dreams, you end up somewhere else, further from home, closer to something you can't put off forever.

See our social links for announcements, sneak peeks, bug reports, and more!
